what: FALSE REJECTION. Honest clean solution: a newtype wrapper `Port` (the solution's own structure) with `instance : Coe Port Int` (coercion OUT of the agent's own type), used in the body to build the ring edges. The rung returns CHEAT_REJECTED claiming the Coe 'applies to task/base types'. Root cause: `Coe (α : semiOutParam ...) (β)` marks the SOURCE as semiOutParam, so classAnchors skips the Port position and only sees Int (base) -> anchors=[] -> flagged. The symmetric `Coe Int Port` (into the agent type) is allowed (see honest/LF3680_instances.lean's `Coe Int Tally`). A `Coe Port Int` can never fire on the frozen postamble (no Port-typed term exists there), so the rejection is false. The rejection message even says 'wrap it in a structure' -- but Port IS a structure.
